scientific_findings.finding: Evaluation originally did not verify frozen routes.csv and fit artifacts. Current implementation hashes routes.csv explicitly and verifies frozen sources plus fit_manifest artifacts.

Summing edgeData waitingTime across consecutive short edges and dividing by window does not guarantee a unique stopped-vehicle population because vehicle bodies can occupy multiple edges. Rename as edge-occupancy proxy or compute unique vehicle counts from per-vehicle time samples. Does not invalidate tripinfo stopped times or one-edge screenline crossing counts.
scientific_findings.resolution: Main metric now uses unique per-step summary.halting;1200 consecutive1s records and means/max independently verified for all4 profiles. Edge spatial sums renamed occupancy proxy with explicit duplicate-count warning.

scientific_findings.finding: Effective speed constraints identify aggregate route impedance conditional on demand and topology; actual speed limits, local signal cycles, physical queue lengths and actual OD rates remain unidentified.

Historical 2025 EIA count621 veh/h supports only order of magnitude. h18 gives600 veh/h from three equally split modeled paths; unknown historical section/direction and mixed vehicle classes preclude a present-day OD validation claim.
Four finite demand profiles and local coordinate search define a tested sensitivity envelope, not confidence/credible intervals, global identification bounds or guaranteed global optimum.
Holdout is retrospective: v1 holdout outcomes already inspected. Current fit uses training medians only and step ETAs receive no duplicate fitting weight.

15% per-OD error screen, 20s insertion budget, factor bounds, event duration, release timing and45/180s gate are engineering design choices, not observations. 20s threshold was changed after smoke diagnostics, before final search; protocol discloses this.

Governance uses direct simulation with same conditional demands, event and physics within pairs; B starts after task release and accounts for all original-release waiting. The A route cost uses current active constraints rather than predicted future recovery. Field causal effects are not claimed.
No globally exhaustive demand identification or global optimizer guarantee. If no starting factor is valid, a profile search cannot prove that all parameter vectors are impossible.

Governance comparisons now separate physically complete comparison_valid from eligible_for_fitted_scenario_conclusion requiring the frozen training consistency screen. All32 rows verified;16 are qualified fitted conditional pairs,16 are diagnostic only.
